headline: GitHub secret-stealing campaign widens to 60,000 repos; N-central exploits beat patches; ScreenConnect plugin flaw spreads malware

bullets.text: New: SecurityWeek reports an attacker targeting 60,000 GitHub repositories in a credential theft campaign. Earlier reports: 4,837 hijacked GitHub accounts ran a CI secret stealer in 1,806+ repos, and Help Net Security says tens of thousands of repos were hit.

The Hacker News reports new N-central exploits that work against patched servers, giving root RCE and Windows SYSTEM access. This follows attacks on N-central zero-days as N-able rushed patches (3 outlets).

The Register reports a ScreenConnect plugin flaw being exploited to spread malware across hundreds of PCs. Related ScreenConnect attacks breached MSPs and affected dozens of organizations (5 outlets).

KEV due today (11-12): GPUStack CVE-2026-102895 (SANS sees exploit attempts), OpenSSH CVE-2026-123158, FreeSwitch CVE-2026-116779, Aspera Faspex CVE-2026-123218. Due 11-13: Barracuda ESG CVE-2026-116606 and CVE-2026-111560, Ivanti Connect Secure CVE-2026-104935.

Notion customer data was compromised in the Fireworks AI hack (6 outlets). PTC patched critical Windchill/FlexPLM RCE CVE-2026-126325. Xen Orchestra and Cisco BroadWorks flaws are being exploited; BroadWorks CVE-2026-20320 is KEV-due 11-24.
New: Romania says it stopped a Russian cyberattack on government email. Also on the board: Maersk data theft, Vanderbilt ransomware lockdown (6 outlets). SITCON 3 holds at 1.07x the 90-day average.

actions: GitHub: review recent workflow runs and commits from unfamiliar accounts, then rotate any CI secrets and tokens those repos can reach.
N-central: do not rely on patches alone; take consoles off the internet now and hunt for root or SYSTEM-level compromise on N-central hosts.
ScreenConnect: inventory instances and plugins, remove unknown clients and plugins, and hunt for malware pushed through remote sessions.
Finish GPUStack, OpenSSH, FreeSwitch and Aspera Faspex KEV fixes today; patch Barracuda ESG and Ivanti Connect Secure by 11-13.
Review data sent through Fireworks AI or Notion AI; patch PTC Windchill/FlexPLM for CVE-2026-126325.
Schedule Outlook, Chromium and Cisco BroadWorks KEV fixes before 11-24; keep Xen Orchestra management off the open internet.
